Only changes the signing of `experimental_toolApprovalSecret`, and old signatures still verify.
It doesn't say what users now see for invalid provider-executed tool calls, or whether the old behavior was a bug.
Adds a new experimental speech translation spec and `experimental_streamTranslate`.
`repairText` is now stable, and the old `experimental_repairText` still works as a deprecated alias.
It only deprecates an `Experimental_`-prefixed type.
The warning banner now goes to stderr instead of stdout, which changes what output consumers see.
It closes a DNS rebinding bypass so validated downloads block private addresses as intended.
`prepareStep` can now override model call settings per step, and older versions would ignore the extra settings at runtime.
Fixes validated Node.js downloads that failed when the connector requested a single DNS address.
`streamText` now keeps provider metadata from empty text deltas, which was previously dropped.
Adds `experimental_toolCaller` routing.
Corrects telemetry attribution for calls that resolve to a different response model.
Adds `experimental_toolCallers` support to `streamText`.

`generateText` now emits a warning when given the streaming-only `firstChunkMs` or `chunkMs` timeouts.
Changes only the experimental video model interface and `experimental_generateVideo`.
Simplifies configuration for the experimental code-mode tool callers.
Stops needless re-validation of terminal UI message parts, which could fail for already-completed tool outputs.
`ToolLoopAgent` `prepareCall` can now read and override `reasoning`.
This is a new export that older versions lack, so importing it fails.
Regenerating a response now keeps the preceding assistant messages, which fixes a bug.
New batch APIs that older versions don't have, so calling them fails.
Provider metadata is now exposed on language-model-call end callbacks and telemetry spans, and older versions simply don't provide it.
It only affects retries in `generateVideo`, which is experimental.
Fixes resumed chat streams that kept running after cancellation and applied stale updates.
Timeouts configured in agent settings were previously ignored and are now applied, changing runtime behavior of existing code.
New 'adaptive' value accepted on generateVideo aspectRatio; it is a type-level widening and older versions would only fail type checks, but older runtime passes it through, so treat as silent.
Bundle size tree-shaking of internal imports has no observable API change.
Adds typed custom bodies to Completion APIs; older versions would reject the new typed usage at type level.
Reasoning UI parts now carry the block IDs from UI message streams, changing the resulting message data.
Fixes a type assignment error so providers without reranking support work as Provider.
Performance optimization of cloning with snapshots preserved; no observable change.
Preserves definitions that should have been kept when wrapping array output schemas, a bug fix.
Errors thrown in Chat onFinish now propagate to the initiating request instead of being swallowed.
Chat status stays 'submitted' longer, until content begins streaming, so code relying on 'streaming' timing behaves differently.
Fixes a declaration emit error, turning a failure into working behavior.
Corrects multi-step loop stopping for client tool approval to the intended behavior.
Result promises now reject and completion is reported as failed when the provider stream errors, where previously they did not.
Makes ignoreIncompleteToolCalls filter preliminary outputs as the option is meant to.
Tools are no longer automatically executed when a model call ends with an unsafe finish reason.
Clears stale partial parts on retry, fixing incorrect duplicated state.
Exceptions in onChunk and onError callbacks no longer terminate the stream or mask provider errors.
Prevents duplicate part ids, a bug fix.
Allows nullish metadata schemas that previously errored for branded IDs, turning a type error into working code.
Approved turns with invalid revalidated tool input now continue with a model-visible tool error instead of the previous handling.
Fixes lost active parts when merged UI streams finish a step.
Only affects experimental_startTextBatch and its webhookUrl option.
Makes structured output parse when finishReason is omitted, turning a failure into working behavior.
Adds an optional reason to manual tool approval statuses and UI messages; older versions would ignore it rather than error.
Persisted typed tool calls are now validated against current schemas and incompatible ones load as dynamic tool parts instead of static typed parts.
Chats now auto-continue after tool approval denials reach output-denied, where previously they stopped.
UI message stream end callbacks now receive operation-level outcomes, a new field callers can use.
Fixes cancellation handling of a stitchable stream before an inner stream is registered, an internal edge-case bug.
Parsed structured output is now exposed in streamText end callbacks as a new callable value.
Fixes settings and prepareCall to accept tool approval secrets as intended, turning a rejection into working behavior.
Fixes smoothStream crashing or misbehaving with stateful and empty-match regexes.
Hash output changes for arrays containing undefined elements, so existing hashes may differ.
Corrects Gateway image-generation cost reporting to the total across split requests.
Change is to the Anthropic provider package, not ai.
Exposes individual image generation calls, a new accessible value.
Adds signed tool approval support to WorkflowAgent.
Fixes approval descriptors being dropped in UI message streams.
generateText now rejects responses violating required tool choices, which previously were accepted.
Says tool calling was added to 'batch' without identifying what API or whether it is in ai.
Adds new file operations and result fields (byteSize, createdAt, expiresAt), and uploadFile now forwards abortSignal/headers.
Adds configurable recovery for mid-stream provider errors via streamRetries and StreamTextOnErrorRetryCallback.
Preserves provider metadata that was being lost from empty smoothStream deltas.
Surfaces fallback errors where empty HTTP response bodies previously gave no useful error.
smoothStream now skips delays while the document is hidden, changing timing for existing code.
streamText onAbort callbacks now receive call ID and abort reason.
Replacing a message with sendMessage now uses a new message ID instead of the old one.
Fixes tool part titles being dropped during UI message validation.
Fixes provider metadata being lost when converting failed tool calls.
Array outputs now support minItems and maxItems constraints.
Only adds already supported callbacks to a type definition.
Decoding text data URLs in Node.js makes ai do what it was meant to; it fixes a bug.
Embedding responses with a mismatched count are now rejected with an error instead of being accepted.
Preserves diagnostics that were lost on failed image generation; a bug fix.
Fixes a crash in environments where AbortSignal is not a constructor.
Adds support for per-request models in batch; older versions would not use it, but it adds no loud rejection.
streamText now enforces tool choices that were previously not enforced, changing behavior of existing calls.
Empty image results are now retried, and Google prompt blocks are treated as terminal, changing retry behavior.
Rejecting empty embedding responses surfaces an error for an invalid result; a bug-fix hardening.
Adds batch cancel and list APIs.
Fixes atob call for Cloudflare Workers compatibility, turning a crash into working behavior.
Prevents unhandled rejections in video webhook handling; a bug fix.
Adds batch cancel and list APIs.
Unsupported batch request types are now rejected with an error.
Adds runtime context attribution to embed, embedMany and rerank.
Adds image generation requests in batches.
Rejects invalid provider indices in reranking; a bug-fix hardening against bad data.
validateUIMessages now accepts inferred tools, turning an error into working behavior.
Adds a stable UI message type and type guard for tool output errors.
Utility input validation now throws InvalidArgumentError, so code catching the previous error type may behave differently.
Exposes typed AI SDK errors for UI transport and completion failures.
Fixes serialization of tool output JSON values; a bug fix.
Changes only experimental client-delegated Live conversations.
Adds an experimental OpenAI Live provider via openai.experimental_realtime.
Settles automatically denied tool calls in UI streams; a bug fix.
Changes only to experimental realtime WebSocket error reporting.
Removes the autoContinueTools option and Live tool-result aliases, and sendTextMessage/addToolOutput now reject continuous sessions.
Adds mid-conversation tool discovery/updates for code-mode, which is new and does not affect code that doesn't use it.
rawInput in output-error UI message parts is deprecated but still works.
Restores the documented DNS validation and connection pinning protection when global fetch is wrapped.
Adds experimental_evaluate and an experimental evaluation specification.
Only extends the experimental evaluation feature with model aliases and registry resolution.
Reports abnormal realtime WebSocket close diagnostics through onError, which was not previously surfaced.
Adds support for tool search with direct tool calling; older versions simply lack it.
Adds a native tool search tool that older versions do not export, so using it fails there.
Changes only how experimental evaluation model IDs are resolved.
Preserves provider metadata when simulating text streams, which is the expected behavior.
Corrects the model reported in streamed step results to match the prepareStep model.
Prevents unhandled rejections when UI message stream reading stops early.
Preserves prototype-named properties in serialized tool outputs that were previously lost.
Closes telemetry spans when provider response streams fail.
Uses the prepareStep-selected model for response metadata fallbacks as documented.
Preserves tool calls needed by retained pending approvals, fixing broken behavior.
Skips input-available callbacks for invalid streamed tool calls, where they should not fire.
Cancels attachment downloads on abort or timeout, matching expected abort semantics.
Fixes JSON fence stripping before trailing whitespace in streamed output.
Fixes streaming of null and empty string JSON partial outputs.
Prevents onEnd from firing after aborting a multi-step text stream.
Makes structured output stream from the final tool-loop step as expected.
wrapProvider now preserves provider file and skill upload APIs that it dropped.
Preserves query parameters in chat reconnect URLs, which were wrongly dropped.
It says WorkflowAgent supports deferred tool discovery but not whether that is new or a repair, or what users would observe.
Preliminary tool outputs no longer wrongly complete a chat, which is the documented behavior.
Fixes lost audio format metadata so output matches what is documented.
Input callbacks now get the tool-specific context they were documented to receive.
Polling timeouts now apply to in-flight requests as documented.
Fixes dropped Set-Cookie headers in Node stream responses.
Fixes duplicated content-type headers in chat transport requests.
Fixes incorrect decoding of base64 text data URLs with a declared charset.
Tools governed by tool callers should never have run directly, so this enforces intended behavior.
Cancellation now stops pending tool-call repairs, as expected.
Fixes file data being lost when adapting v3 language models.
streamText now respects toolChoice as documented.
Fixes loading and cancel state for replacement completion requests.
Fixes overlapping text blocks being lost in reasoning extraction streams.
The change is to the harness package, aligning it with ToolLoopAgent.
Only affects experimental_evaluate.
Generated files from URL-backed outputs now carry the real base64 and bytes they were documented to expose.
Removing reasoning now also removes reasoning file parts, as it should.
UI message stream end callbacks now report consumer cancellation, which older versions did not expose; older versions ignore it silently.
Fixes opaque file URI strings being altered during provider serialization.
Validation now keeps parsed metadata and data values instead of losing them.
Completed streamed tool input callbacks now reach repaired tools as expected.
Video models from legacy fallback providers were being lost and are now preserved.
Fixes Google embedMany calls with more than 100 values, which previously failed or misaligned content.
Tool approvals from earlier messages can now be resumed, fixing a failing case.
Makes manually approved tool inputs from schema transforms execute, turning a failure into working behavior.

Restores message history for direct transport stream callbacks, which is the expected behavior.
Lint rule change with no user-observable effect.

Only clarifies code comments about allowSystemInMessages, no behavior change.
Build target change to ES2022 with no API change for users.
Opaque URI strings are now preserved and unsupported URL MIME subtypes are no longer forwarded to providers, changing what is sent.
Cancelling response streams on client disconnect is a bug fix to expected behavior.

Preserves tool metadata from output chunks that was being lost, matching expected behavior.

Clarification only; runtime behavior is stated as unchanged.

Build tooling migration from tsup to tsdown.
Preserves partial reasoning tags at part end, correcting lost text.

Cancels merged UI message streams when the consumer disconnects, which is the expected behavior.
Turns a rejection of valid approval inputs into working behavior.
New option for tool search; older versions ignore it at runtime and code that doesn't use it is unaffected.
Bug fix restoring approval state on stream resume.
Rename of `evaluate` to `decide` with no indication of which API it belongs to or whether it is stable.
WorkflowAgent belongs to the workflow package, not ai itself.
New delimiter option on an existing middleware; older versions ignore it and existing calls are unchanged.
Silent audio now returns an empty transcript instead of failing.
A different error class is thrown; existing catch blocks for Error still work but behave differently when checking the type.

Bug fix preserving provider-reported total tokens in raw usage.

Bug fix for error reporting after failed resume attempts.
Bug fix preserving provider options from approval-only tool messages.
Bug fix recognizing WebKit network errors.
Bug fix preventing unavailable tools from exposing persisted output.
Bug fix avoiding duplicate slashes in reconnect URLs.
TypeScript toolchain upgrade with no user-observable change.
Change is to the harness package.
Bug fix so abort rejects pending promises and cancels the stream rather than hanging.
Concerns decision providers, which are experimental.
New callback option; older versions ignore it and existing code is unaffected.
Changes only the experimental decision state.
Bug fix so async sendAutomaticallyWhen failures are propagated rather than lost.
Bug fix preserving provider-executed tool calls on stream resume.
Bug fix preventing duplicate continuation requests.
A tool loop that hits the default step limit now logs a warning, so existing code produces new output.
